LESSON: GUIDED READING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.1 Reading Aloud (2 lessons) • Initials and finals • Chinese tones • Pr
Topic 2.2: Guided Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Reading, part of Reading 2.1 Reading Aloud (2 lessons) • Initials and finals • Chinese tones • Pr in Grade 4 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How do you read tones correctly to enhance communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read out vocabulary related to nuclear family members from a family tree with the correct tones (爸爸、妈妈、姐姐、哥哥、弟弟、妹 妹、女儿、儿子),

2. find titles of nuclear family members from a crossword puzzle and read them out,

3. conduct a reading game on sentences about nuclear family members with appropriate tones for peer feedback,

4. indicate whether the pictures provided correspond to the words accompanying them (判断对错),

5. read out rhymes related to nuclear family members collaboratively,

6. express the importance of individual family members in their nuclear family.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read out vocabulary related to nuclear family members from a family tree with the correct tones (爸爸、妈妈、姐姐、哥哥、弟弟、妹 妹、女儿、儿子),
2. find titles of nuclear family members from a crossword puzzle and read them out,
3. conduct a reading game on sentences about nuclear family members with appropriate tones for peer feedback,
4. indicate whether the pictures provided correspond to the words accompanying them (判断对错),
5. read out rhymes related to nuclear family members collaboratively,
6. express the importance of individual family members in their nuclear family.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: The learner engages actively when working with peers to identify vocabulary related to

the theme from a crossword puzzle.

Values:
• Responsibility: This is enhanced as the learner diligently dedicates their time to finish the tasks assigned.

• Respect is nurtured as the learner makes honest and constructive feedback during the peer review on the sentence

reading game.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion is promoted as the learner expresses and acknowledges the importance of individual family members in the

nuclear family.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner links their learning to Religious Education on the concept of family and their importance in promoting social

cohesion.
